songs.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1: Female Vocal]
I opened the door to colder air
And paused upon the step
My breath made small clouds
The street I knew from yesterday
Had changed while others slept
Every maple wore a color
I had not seen coming yet

[Chorus: Male and Female Duet]
One small breath above my sweater
Color Came Home
Summer's leaving did not wound me
It simply changed the road

[Verse 2: Male Vocal]
A kettle clicked inside the kitchen
But I stayed out by the rail
A porch flag stirred without a sound
Leaves lay bright along the sidewalk
The mailbox wore one yellow leaf
Like postcards in the pale
Mild surprise became a blessing
Settled easy in my bones

[Chorus: Male and Female Duet]
Past each gate and waking window
Color Came Home
What I thought was only ending
Held a grateful glow

[Instrumental Break]

[Final Chorus: Male and Female Duet Harmony]
Color Came Home
One small breath above my sweater
Summer's leaving did not wound me
It simply changed the road
I stood still and thanked the morning
Color Came Home

songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He lifts the latch in the front room
Where winter kept its chair
The curtain jumps like it remembers
How to move in kinder air
Dust turns gold above the table
And the house begins to breathe

[Chorus]
Long cold weeks loosen their fingers
Open Every Window
Warmth walks in across the floor
With nothing left to prove

[Verse 2]
He opens one above the kitchen
One beside the narrow stair
A letter stirs near an old cup
As if a voice were there
The heavy rooms give back their silence
To the branches newly green

[Chorus]
From sill to sill the whole house answers
Open Every Window
What felt closed is only waiting
For the air to move

[Bridge]
He does not say the winter ended
He only lets it pass
Sun rests softly on the table
Like a hand on glass

[Instrumental Break]

[Final Chorus]
Open Every Window
Long cold weeks loosen their fingers
Warmth walks in across the floor
With nothing left to prove
The first light waits beside the table
Open Every Window
